name: Azata, Tulani
body:
TULANI AZATA
CR 18

This being resembles a tall, stately elven noble dressed in shimmering robes of shifting colors. Its skin is pale, and its hair and eyes appear to change in hue following its mood.

XP 153,600
CG Medium outsider (azata, chaotic, extraplanar, good, shapechanger)
Init +10; Senses darkvision 60 ft., detect evil, detect law, detect magic, low-light vision, true seeing; Perception +28
Aura holy aura

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 21, flat-footed 26 (+6 Dex, +4 deflection, +1 dodge, +12 natural)
hp 243 (18d10+144)
Fort +22, Ref +16, Will +22
DR 15/cold iron and evil; Immune electricity, petrification; Resist cold 10, fire 10; SR 27

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 90 ft. (perfect)
Melee +4 brilliant energy holy longsword +27/+22/+18/+12 (1d8+9/19-20 plus 2d6 holy)
Ranged dream ray +24 ranged touch (1d6 Cha/300 ft.)
Special Attacks bardic performance (46 rounds/day; countersong, deadly performance, distraction, fascinate, frightening tune, inspire competence +4, inspire courage +4, inspire greatness, inspire heroics, mass suggestion, soothing performance; DC 27), gaze Spell-Like Abilities (CL 18th, concentration +26)

Constant—detect evil, detect law, detect magic, holy aura, true seeing
At will—chain lightning (DC 24), cure serious wounds, dancing lights, detect thoughts (DC 20), dispel magic, divine favor, haste, holy word (DC 25), greater invisibility, greater teleport (self plus 50 lb. of objects only), major image (DC 20), mass charm monster (DC 26), telekinesis (DC 23), wall of force
3/day—empowered chain lightning (DC 24)
1/day—heal, meteor swarm (DC 27), power word kill, time stop

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Elysium’s Benevolence (Su)

At will, a tulani can make good-aligned creatures immune to the harmful effects of its spell-like and supernatural abilities.

Gaze (Su)

In humanoid form, a tulani’s gaze attack slays evil creatures with 5 HD or less (range 60 feet, Will DC 27 negates). Non-evil creatures and evil creatures with more than 5 HD must succeed on a DC 27 Will save or be blinded and shaken for 2d10 rounds. A creature that saves against a tulani’s gaze is immune to that particular tulani’s gaze for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Light Form (Su)

A tulani can shift between its solid body and a scintillating sphere of rainbow-hued light as a standard action. In solid form, it cannot fly or use its dream ray. In light form, it can fly and gains the incorporeal quality—it can make dream ray attacks or use spell-like abilities in this form, but can’t make physical attacks or use its gaze. This ability otherwise functions similarly to a bralani’s wind form ability.

Sword of Light (Su)

A tulani can create a +4 brilliant energy holy longsword at will as a free action. If the tulani dies or loses physical contact with the sword, the sword disappears immediately.

ABOUT

Tulani, or faerie lords, are the nobility of azatas. Though the elusive veranallia are more powerful, tulani are the real guides and figures to look at for the denizens of Elysium, only subject to the loose will of CG empyreal lords.

Tulani keep their courts loosely scattered through their native plane, concealed by powerful spells to unwanted intruders. They are interested in guiding mortals on the right path through subtle influences and gifts of good luck; a tulani spellcaster is often referred to as a fata (arbiter of destiny) in the legends and tales of several worlds.
